optimization_reports.summary:
## Token Budget Reduction — First Optimization Round

### Problem Diagnosis
Baseline eval (iter_01): 48/49 questions failing, **with most failures due to token/turn budget overruns, not correctness**. Sampled examples:
- IG_abacus_001: 12/14 criteria passed, failed `token_budget_total` (46,835 vs 25,000) and `turn_budget` (19 vs 18)
- IG_abacus_004: 11/13 passed, failed `token_budget_total` (20,227 vs 8,000) and `turn_budget` (10 vs 8)
- WO_general_perov_007: 8/9 passed, failed `token_budget_total` (30,977 vs 9,000)
- DF_mech_001: 7/8 passed, failed `token_budget_total` (14,017 vs 8,000) — only 3 turns!
- DD_data_qc_plot_001: 15/17 passed, failed both budget criteria

Base system prompt context is ~12,200 tokens at turn 1, while many token budgets are 6,000–25,000.

### Changes Made

**1. Trimmed all 41 skill descriptions** (~1,200 token savings per API call)
- Every skill's `description` field in SKILL.md frontmatter is included via `get_meta_info_context()` in every API call. Reduced all 41 descriptions from avg ~60 tokens to avg ~15 tokens each.
- Examples: `abacus` from 35-word enumeration to 12-word intent trigger; `input-manual-helper` from 50-word feature list to 17-word intent trigger; Chinese lazymcp descriptions normalized to concise English.

**2. Trimmed SkillTool prompt** (~100 token savings per API call)
- Reduced `skill_tool.py` `prompt()` from 150+ tokens (full instruction block with examples) to ~30 tokens (minimal invocation hint).

**3. Leaned out ABACUS SKILL.md body** (~800 token savings when loaded for 8 IG_abacus tasks)
- Compressed the verbose "INPUT Pre-delivery Checklist" (5 subsections, ~500 tokens) into a condensed 6-line summary (~100 tokens) that references `references/input_examples.md` for details.

**4. Leaned out input-manual-helper SKILL.md body** (~600 token savings when loaded)
- Removed duplicated ABACUS section (now says "load abacus skill for details")
- Compressed workflow sections from ~400 tokens to ~50 tokens
- Compressed principles + knowledge source + physical checks from ~300 tokens to ~50 tokens

**5. Leaned out structure-manager SKILL.md body** (~200 token savings when loaded)
- Compressed verbose Rules section from 9 rules to 4 essential rules

**6. Wrote `proposed_matmaster_exps_changes.md`** for _base.toml and direct.toml trimming
- Cannot modify `matmaster/exps/` directly per constraints
- Proposed ~300 token reduction from `_base.toml` and ~500 token reduction from `direct.toml`
- If accepted: additional ~800 tokens savings per API call

### Expected Impact
- **Skill descriptions**: ~1,200 tokens saved per API call (affects every turn of every task)
- **SkillTool prompt**: ~100 tokens saved per API call
- **ABACUS SKILL.md**: ~800 tokens saved when loaded (8 IG_abacus tasks)
- **input-manual-helper SKILL.md**: ~600 tokens saved when loaded
- **structure-manager SKILL.md**: ~200 tokens saved when loaded
- **Total base context reduction**: ~1,300 tokens per API call (from ~12,200 to ~10,900)
- If exp proposals accepted: additional ~800 tokens → ~10,100 base context

### Limitations
Some questions have token budgets (6,000–8,000) that remain unreachable even after optimization, since the base context with all tool schemas + system prompt is fundamentally ~10,000+ tokens. These may need checklist review.

outcome.rationale:
## Iteration 1 — Baseline Results

### Score
- **macro_mean_0_100 = 2** (1 out of 49 questions fully passed all 3 repeats)
- Target: 60 → **NOT MET**

### P0 Gate
- P0 gate **passed** (no prior baseline to regress against)
- All 7 P0 questions scored 0 (DD_general_004, IG_abacus_002, IG_abacus_003, SC_struct_009, WO_direct_archive_extract_002, WO_direct_exact_filename_002, WO_direct_spec_priority_002)

### Per-Question Results (49 questions, k=3)
| Status | Count | Details |
|---|---|---|
| ✅ Fully passed (3/3 repeats) | 1 | BP_struct_003 |
| ⚠️ Near-pass (1–2/3 repeats) | 8 | BP_elec_001, BP_struct_005, BP_struct_006, CR_BP_HT_adsorption_tree, CR_WO_feature_extract, SC_struct_006, SC_struct_009, SC_struct_010 |
| ❌ All repeats failed | 40 | All remaining questions |

### Capability Breakdown
- **IG (ABACUS input gen)**: 0/8 passed — largest consistent failure block
- **SC (structure construction)**: 0/10 passed (3 near-pass)
- **WO (workflow orchestration)**: 0/8 passed
- **CR (cross-reference)**: 0/5 passed (2 near-pass)
- **BP (batch processing)**: 1/5 passed (3 near-pass) — closest to working
- **DF/DD/DFT/SR/pl**: 0/12 passed combined

### Actions Taken
- Delegated **optimization round 1** targeting skill layer (ABACUS input gen, structure construction, workflow orchestration), tool layer (descriptions/contracts), and system_prompt. Focus on stabilizing near-pass questions and addressing systematic ABACUS failures.

### Next Steps
- Optimization sub-agent will analyze raw_runs.jsonl and pending_ingest to identify specific failure patterns, then make targeted skill/tool changes to improve pass rates across the broadest capabilities.
